additional_info.subject: RE: ID0443170/DC/Si-D/-IL[MP / R6 170002067]Charging station not available CRM:02681000612
additional_info.body:
Dear Orel,
I am writing you to summarize our conversation via Teams. This ticket
ID0443170
was opened for a black screen issue on charger
MP/R6 170002067
(out of warranty case).
You already clarified that all the Q-feedbacks were followed,
the check on the 24V line to the HMI controller was performed, the DP cable replaced, but unfortunately this did not help. According to the guidelines, the HMI has to be replaced.
As per our conversation, the issue is that the HMI showed problems right after the end of the warranty period, and you are seeking for support in order of warranty claim and cost coverage. As you did already, I can only redirect you to the right contacts and departments in our organization, who could support you and discuss this matter with you.
From service side, we can only provide you support in terms of technical understanding of the issue and, as per our current guidelines, advise you to replace the HMI.
As you mentioned also that few more display have reported the same behavior over the past months/years, I will take care to align with Michele Sambiagio, and have a look at the numbers and the reported cases. In case there will be the need and according to our KPIs, we will get in contact with Product Care for a deeper analysis of the reported cases.
As per now, please proceed to replace the DLogic HMI with a RAFI one. Here you can find the spare parts you need to perform the replacement:
